title: Attempted denial of service against a MELSEC iQ-R controller with a non-affected version

attacker_profile.description: An attacker controlling an engineering workstation with network access to the PLC.

attack_path.name: Initial Access
attack_path.description: The attacker gains control of an engineering workstation.

attack_path.name: Access to PLC Network
attack_path.description: The attacker reaches the PLC network.

attack_path.name: Reach Controller
attack_path.description: The attacker reaches the R04CPU over the industrial network.

attack_path.name: Crafted Packet Attack
attack_path.description: The attacker attempts to send a specially crafted packet intended to disrupt controller execution or communications.
required_conditions: The targeted vulnerability affects the deployed version.

attack_path.name: Attempted Denial of Service
attack_path.description: The attacker attempts to force the controller into an error or denial-of-service condition.
required_conditions: A valid vulnerability matching the deployed version is triggered.

attack_path.name: Impact
attack_path.description: If successful, loss of controller execution or communication could impair process availability.
required_conditions: The attack causes controller or communication unavailability.

global_preconditions: The target is an R04CPU running version 53.
The attacker can reach the controller network.
assumptions: The system should reject a CVE when the affected version range excludes the deployed version.
The threat story should remain even if no CVE is validated.
